name: Do I need a permit for an exterior entry ramp installation in the Bay Area?

mainEntity.name: Do I need a permit for an exterior entry ramp installation in the Bay Area?

acceptedAnswer.text: In many Bay Area cities, including our service areas like San Francisco and surrounding municipalities, permits are typically required for permanent exterior entry ramp installations, especially if they involve structural changes, significant grading, or impact public right-of-way. Permitting ensures compliance with local building codes, safety standards, and accessibility regulations such as ADA guidelines. We assist with navigating the permit application process to ensure your project meets all local requirements.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, permits are often required for permanent exterior ramp installations in the Bay Area to ensure compliance with local building and accessibility codes.
